torso_fit.note: mount on T03's floor (zp 3); worst area of any part outside the free space of each tube as it slides past, with 0 and 1 mm clearance

screws.base: 4 x M3 down through the counterbores (2.8 mm of base under the head): with the torso (+3 mm floor, 5 mm plate) M3x14 into the nuts / ear nuts, M3x16 if an ear nut doesn't catch; without the torso M3x12 + nut
screws.battery strap: 2 x M3x10 (3 mm bar + 7 into the pouch-wall bosses)
screws.raspberry pi: 4 x M2.5x10 (1.4 board + 3 standoff + 3 spine + 3 front boss, pilot 2.5 through)
screws.waveshare: 4 x M2.5x8 (1.6 board + 4 standoff + 2.4 of the 3 mm spine; pilot 2.5 through)
screws.imu: 2 x M3x6 or M3x8 (pilot 2.9, 8 deep from the boss top)
